fe24dbb7: ;
 ;DGJCSL is the integration routine for the coreFLS Vendor interface.
 ;It manages the addition, editing, and deletion of CoreFLS Vendor records,
 ;as well as the transmission of HL7 ADT messages to CoreFLS.

95494531: ;
 ;ADD is the entry point for creating a new CoreFLS Vendor record.
 ;It checks if the CoreFLS Vendor interface is active and calls the
 ;STAND^DGBTCSL routine to handle vendor record creation.
176dff35: Check if the CoreFLS Vendor interface FileMan file (#392.31) exists
d46b4289: Display an error message if the CoreFLS Vendor interface is not active
849be8fb: Call the STAND^DGBTCSL routine to handle vendor record creation
